contract.count_rule: Only rows with counts_toward_contract=true and proof_status=proven count.

forks.title: Choose a lived-in Albany character background
forks.visible_choice: Choose one of four permanent Albany backgrounds. Every option previews its contact, rank-4 skill edge, rank-4 value, equipment package, funds, faction standing, knowledge, and active obligation; the Road-Warden option explicitly previews Wolf-Winter DEF 3→4, while the other three explicitly state that they do not receive that import.
delayed_consumers: Rowan and the selected sponsor resolve memory-conditioned contact responses from the persistent relationship state.
Wolf-Winter's generic campaign import catalog raises the Road-Warden's starting defense floor from 3 to 4 while a Ledger Advocate remains at the pack default of 3.
At the broken paling, an identical d20 roll of 7 braces the rail for DEF 4 but splits it for DEF 3, exposing different next legal actions and the authored bind-the-split-rail recovery.

Every supported non-death Wolf-Winter return closes exactly the selected background's active obligation as kept: Hayden's honest packet, Rowan's truthful account, Reese's borrowed tools, or the existing emergency-tag closure. Unrelated quest outcomes leave it active, and no other background promise is invented.
visible_feedback: The registration screen names each contact, skill rank, value rank, kit, obligation, persistence consequence, and the current Wolf import limitation before confirmation.
The persistent-character panel shows the exact canonical package after confirmation; the registration journal records the authored concept, previewed resources, and permanent consequence.
Rowan and Hayden identify the remembered registration in authored later contact copy; Wolf-Winter's visible starting DEF and rail-check outcome expose the mechanical consumer.

At truthful foldback, full, compact, and UI character views change only the selected registration obligation from active to kept; the ordinary terminal completion and bounded compact MCP result immediately show one authenticated profile-specific receipt naming the correct recipient, Courier witness, or exact 100/100 repair roll. Replay and restore rederive that receipt from the complete current dispatch proof, reject missing or swapped evidence, treat a content-hash mismatch only as provenance, and remain idempotent on a second restore.

forks.title: Define what the relief rider owes Albany
forks.visible_choice: Immediately after permanent registration and before source certification, bind exactly one irreversible Wolf-Winter term. Take Full Compact Duty for 10 minutes, negotiate Aid-Only Duty for 5 minutes, or remain an Unaffiliated Helper on a witnessed personal bond for 0 minutes. Every card discloses its access, duty, field consequence, promise consequence, and conditional return service; none removes hunt, lure, drive, fortify, June, or solo play.
delayed_consumers: Full Compact Duty imports Rowan's boundary annex. If the player later chooses Albany-authority fortification, it lowers the first public-seal Repair check from DC 14 to 12, or from the Works-prepared DC 12 to 10, without changing Cade's refusal, the spent attempt, pressure, or Albany-strip recovery. Choosing Cade's legal household fortification remains available but truthfully breaks this public-seal term.

Aid-Only Duty imports Jamie's witnessed count slip. Only when the first lure cast stayed clean does the final scent cast suppress its ordinary +1 cattle-alarm step; a fouled opening keeps that final pressure even after a living recovery, while approach pressure, recovery costs, and every other strategy retain their original consequences. Invoking Albany authority remains legal but releases the limited promise with Rowan's recorded public bend.

The Unaffiliated Personal Bond imports Emery's ash-lane service-cut insert. It lowers only the first drive shutter check from DC 12 to 10; the finite charge, failed-check alarm, no-retry rule, loose-hurdle recovery, and all other strategies remain unchanged. Invoking Albany authority remains legal but breaks the personal bond.

Quest foldback resolves each active oath in the truthful return record: Full Duty is kept except when Cade's household shutters substitute for its required public seals, Aid-Only is kept except for the released authority bend, and the Unaffiliated Bond is kept except when authority breaks it. The distinct Unaffiliated Courier registration-tag promise also closes as kept on any truthful Wolf-Winter return under all three terms, while other backgrounds never invent it. Matching kept proof and outcome facts conditionally unlock one 15-minute service: Civic resupply after lawful full-duty authority fortification, Market rest after an aid-only living-pack/whole-herd return, or Greenway resupply after a qualifying unaffiliated living-drive returned-rig line. Equivalent same-counter claims consolidate rather than duplicate stock or recovery: Relief Protocol with the full-duty Civic cache, Resident Shelter with the aid-only Market cot, and a whole-herd drive with the unaffiliated Greenway cache.
visible_feedback: Before any commitment, the selected role's matched duty-and-evidence shortcut is immediately actionable, while Customize exposes a read-only outcome compass that gives HUNT, LURE, DRIVE, and FORTIFY equal desired-outcome/cost framing and recommends no plan before revealing all three ordinary duties. The durable offer/selection journal still states the selected exact 10/5/0-minute cost, access, duty, field benefit, overstep consequence, return promise, and any same-counter service consolidation before confirmation; the persistent character record then exposes its value, faction standing, Rowan memory, knowledge, and active promise.

Cade's authored strategy conversation, room variants, legal action copy, displayed DC, cattle-alarm change, and action journal name the selected term where it is consumed while leaving the nonmatching strategies visible and legal.

On return, chronological campaign foldback exposes the promise as kept, released, or broken with Rowan's matching memory. Eligible Albany service copy names the exact oath and outcome facts that opened its one-time 15-minute benefit.

forks.title: Investigate Wolf-Winter through a chosen Albany source
forks.visible_choice: After permanent character registration, certify exactly one controlling Wolf-Winter account: Rowan's immediate civic docket, Jamie Tanner's paid market testimony, or Hayden Hale's timed frost-heave report. The opening mission preview is already visible, but Wolf-Winter's quest card, live launch approaches, and discovered state remain hidden until this irreversible choice is made.
delayed_consumers: Rowan's docket preserves the complete import-independent Wolf-Winter route without either private-source action.

Without committing Cade's finite feed plan, Jamie's certified testimony alone opens the feed-hauler crawlboard after the yearling falls as a rail-free combat drop behind the flank-wolf. Cade can independently teach the same physical board only as the second cast of his irreversible nonlethal plan; that local instruction neither imports Jamie's evidence nor grants Jamie's combat opening.

Hayden's certified frost report alone turns a failed, deliberately unbound paling rail into a high-variance +4 ATK/-2 DEF frost-brace trip followed by a -1 ATK/+2 DEF drive; binding the familiar guard commits away from that line.
Jamie and Hayden remember which account was certified, while their matching registration sponsorship changes the actual time and money paid before departure.
visible_feedback: The blocking three-card choice states each packet's exact source, actual sponsored or public cost, commitment, and later Wolf-Winter consumer before confirmation.
Certifying one source immediately exposes Wolf-Winter's authored mission card and both hill-approach previews while the separate preparation decision remains pending.
The persistent journal records the certified source and paid terms; the character panel exposes money, knowledge, and source memory after confirmation.
Wolf-Winter's room descriptions, legal exits, visible maneuver commands and bonuses, and mutually exclusive follow-up actions cite only the account actually certified.

forks.title: Earn, reject, or lose an Albany ally
forks.visible_choice: After certifying one Albany source and reaching the Station Quarter, speaking with Road Warden June Pike independently presents three irreversible field-team terms with exact capability, condition, and cost: grant her cattle-first authority and spend 15 minutes for a companion and active promise; ask for a subordinate relay and spend 5 minutes to receive her authored refusal; or leave explicitly solo with no added time. Preparation and relief allocation remain separately optional in either order, while departing without asking June remains a truthful solo default and invents no relationship evidence. If June rides, the last pre-HUNT boundary adds a second irreversible relationship fork: release her amicably and commit HUNT now, preserving the relationship while closing LURE/DRIVE/FORTIFY and forfeiting every June intervention with no replacement bonus; or retain her through the crossing and accept that the first wolf death breaks the agreement.
delayed_consumers: Wolf-Winter imports only a real companion as `june_pike_present`; direct and solo starts keep exact pack defaults. Before an uncommitted player can cross into the paling with June, she names the ordinary rail as hunt-and-hold combat and blocks the crossing until the player explicitly acknowledges that line, releases her, or commits lure, drive, or fortification. A release commits HUNT immediately, clears her field presence, closes all three living-plan inspect and commit surfaces, and leaves only ordinary HUNT lessons, gear, backtracking, and the north crossing; retaining her preserves the existing crossing boundary.

On a committed fouled lure, either a successful brace or the existing bound split-rail failure recovery exposes an explicit scent-pen that redirects the yearling alive; the ordinary guarded rail remains a disclosed hunt-and-hold combat tactic. June then blocks the final scent cast until she independently refuses the wolf line, takes the cattle line, and lowers cattle alarm by 1.

With identical prior state, June's LURE action changes cattle alarm 4 and a scattered-herd ending into alarm 3 and a whole-herd ending. On DRIVE, her mandatory lower-gate action holds Pack Drive at Crisis: a failed-signal Overrun falls 3 to 2 without the solo route's -2 HP brace, while a clean signal already at 2 receives no synthetic reduction. On FORTIFY, an unstabilized failed first seal reaches Strained pressure 3 at dawn: intact June's lower cattle brace prevents the persistent -2 HP watch strain without lowering pressure or changing the stance ending, while solo or broken-June routes pay it. A clean pressure-2 line and a mobile-stabilized line cost no HP and gain no extra June benefit, including when delayed dispatch leaves the stabilized line at displayed pressure 3. Releasing June before HUNT clears all three intervention surfaces without changing HP, attack, defense, score, inventory, legal HUNT tactics, RNG, or costs. Retaining her means any first wolf death breaks her disclosed condition, removes the action without blocking completion, and later resolves the promise broken while removing her from the party.

Conditional quest exports resolve the cattle-first promise kept, released, or broken in chronological replay, preserve June's ending-specific memory, and drive matching Station testimony. The four released HUNT endings preserve the exact non-June effects of bloodied evacuation, gate-barred, timber-saved, and timber-spent outcomes plus every tactical prose variant, but remove June, record an amicable release, and grant no kept-companion service. A living-pack return gives the kept companion one one-time 15-minute Station resupply; her negotiated relay refusal instead gives one distinct Station rest; explicit solo, amicable release, and relationship loss receive no June service.
visible_feedback: A read-only Station departure contact lead names June's optional field team and is immediately actionable beside the independent preparation and relief-allocation interactions. It keeps immediate solo launch visibly legal without creating an offer or decision. Speaking with June remains the only action that opens the blocking field-team screen and durable offer journal; its first tier states the human priority, field capability, exact cost, and give-up, while read-only expansion carries the authenticated timing proof and full consequence. The persistent character panel then shows companion and promise state.

Cade's menu and the last pre-paling June boundary distinguish guarded hunt-and-hold from the lure, drive, and fortification commitments. The release card states relationship preservation, immediate HUNT commitment, closure of all three living plans, loss of every later June intervention, and no combat/cattle bonus. After selection, full and compact room/Cade copy plus legal actions show HUNT already committed, north open, ordinary preparation intact, and no strategy retry.

After a fouled lure, state-specific room prose and legal actions distinguish the braced-rail scent-pen from the bound-split-guard scent-pen. The first spear strike irreversibly commits the hybrid line and retires every living recovery; killing that wolf then breaks June's agreement on the Albany return.

June's DRIVE and FORTIFY conversations plus blocked resolution actions disclose that her lower cattle line, not a combat bonus, preserves 2 HP only at failed-signal Overrun or an unstabilized failed fortification seal at pressure 3+. Clean DRIVE, pressure-2 FORTIFY, and mobile-stabilized FORTIFY—even at delayed pressure 3—gain no extra reduction; June does not lower fortification pressure or change its ending.

On return, June's memory-conditioned Station account, companion/promise projection, and cause-named service state distinguish cooperation, refusal, solo travel, amicable pre-HUNT release, and relationship loss across full, compact, UI, and restored views.

forks.title: Commit limited time and money to a preparation profile
forks.visible_choice: After certifying one Albany source and reaching the Station Quarter, optionally inspect and commit one urgent specialist packet independently of relief allocation and June's field-team terms: Reese's Works fortification sequence, Emery's drover route, or Jamie's relief protocol. The three support spokes remain legal in any order and any unresolved spoke is explicitly declined only at launch. The first tier of every preparation card names its human priority, exact public or sponsored time-and-money cost, and give-up. An exact read-only expansion then names its one-shot Wolf consumer, DC 12 check, current matching skill modifier and d20 success chance, failure consequence, provider memory, mutually exclusive return service, and authenticated final dispatch range with already-selected support fixed before confirmation. Emery's authored field terms disclose both its failed-LURE and failed-DRIVE consumers, compare failure with declining the route, and state that DRIVE still requires its loose hurdle; both hill launches remain legal without a selection.
delayed_consumers: Wolf-Winter imports only the selected plan flag plus the character's matching Repair, Streetwise, or Mediation rank. Direct starts retain exact zero-rank, no-plan defaults.
Works replaces the public paling wedge with one Repair check. A miss preserves the split rail, then Reese's marked cold-set restores the breach without a reroll while raising cattle alarm by 1.

Drover appears after either the first lure cast or DRIVE shutter fails and shares one-use retirement across both consumers. On LURE, success redirects the living yearling and lowers cattle alarm by 1 while failure preserves rail-or-fight recovery at the same pressure. On DRIVE, success removes the failed shutter's extra pack-pressure beat while failure leaves it; both outcomes still require the loose hurdle. After the final signal, unrecovered pressure reaches Overrun and requires a persistent -2 HP swing-gate brace before the same three crisis priorities unlock.

Relief appears only after the ordinary split-rail recovery redirects the yearling. Success lowers cattle alarm by 1 before the loft cast; failure raises it by 1 and retires without blocking completion.

A truthful held-byre return pairs each selected plan with one different 15-minute service: Works District resupply, Campus rest, or Civic Core resupply. Paired low-supply and fatigued states include paid preparation, shortest Albany relocation, and each alternative profile's best matching service; each profile wins somewhere, so none dominates globally.
visible_feedback: The pull-based Station hub leads with direct launch, one compressed selected-plan clock, preparation and allocation labels, and an actionable June lead for all four backgrounds and all three source choices. Default option comparisons omit repeated timing proofs and check arithmetic; exact read-only expansion restores those authenticated details without a decision or state change. Every one of the sixteen ordered support subsets restores exactly, departure remains legal outside a pending offer, and an accepted choice records the exact paid terms, learned plan, and provider memory.

Wolf room variants, legal commands, narrated skill arithmetic, cattle-alarm and pack-drive bands, shared one-shot retirement, mandatory DRIVE hurdle, prepared pressure recovery, and unprepared overrun strain name the selected plan and its actual consequence.

Representative LURE and DRIVE Drover routes prove full MCP, compact MCP, browser, and RPG save parity. Paired deterministic proofs carry prepared success, prepared failure, and no-plan DRIVE states through the same three crisis priorities; core-session proofs cover all three matching return services and causes, while journal-bound story-choice proof consumes each one-time benefit across restore.

forks.title: Spend Albany's limited relief capacity before departure
forks.visible_choice: After certifying one Albany source and reaching the Station Quarter, optionally inspect a five-minute assignment of Albany's one unallocated winter-relief wagon and crew before or after preparation and June's field-team terms. Send fodder and drovers ahead to Cade's herd, keep Jamie's Market warm room staffed for vulnerable residents, or hold Hayden's wagon at the hill turn as a mobile failure crew. Every first-tier card names what it protects, the two needs left exposed, and its five-minute cost; exact read-only expansion carries the authenticated resulting dispatch time and proof. Choosing is irreversible, while both hill launches remain legal without choosing.
delayed_consumers: Exactly one allocation knowledge imports as exactly one Wolf-Winter flag. On a successful first lure cast from the exposed ridge, Cade's pre-feed suppresses the ordinary alarm increase; seed 26 reaches alarm 3 and the whole-herd living-pack ending, while the same route under resident shelter reaches alarm 4 and scatters two cattle. A failed cast and the sheltered route keep their full consequences, and no feed item or retry is created.

The mobile crew is legal only after the first fortification seat failed and the chosen Cade-help or Albany-authority recovery already joined the seam. It acts once, lowers Winter Siege pressure by 1, preserves the failed-check and stance-cost flags, and selects the truthful failed-then-mobile-stabilized dawn branch under either stance.

Resident shelter adds no Wolf field action. Its exact story-choice proof plus the trusted byre-held return fact unlocks one 15-minute Market rest instead of the ordinary 240-minute service. Mobile reserve uses the same completion gate to unlock one 15-minute Campus resupply instead of the ordinary 45-minute service. The offers are mutually exclusive and each is consumed through the generic campaign-service journal.

The offer, equal five-minute cost, selected provider memory, quest import, field result, return fact, and service eligibility survive chronological foldback and save/restore. The current hub proves allocation before or after preparation and June, with permutation-equivalent material state for the same selected subset. Structural restore preserves a real allocation after the ally proof and re-restores with both sets of effects; a content hash never invents allocation knowledge, memory, cost, field aid, or service.
visible_feedback: Full, compact, browser, CLI, and MCP surfaces show the optional single-wagon interaction, equal five-minute cost, named provider, protected need, two exposed needs, exact inspect/choose arguments, and legal departure before commitment. The default tier omits repeated timing-proof objects; exact read-only expansion restores the authenticated dispatch impact and consequence, while the journal and persistent character state retain an accepted allocation afterward.

After allocation and before quest start, the bounded hill-route tradeoff summary recomputes both roads from that exact choice: Cade fodder suppresses only the exposed ridge's clean first-cast alarm, while the sheltered stockway explicitly remains unchanged.

Wolf-Winter's imported flag, named pre-feed alarm result or mobile-crew action, visible pressure track, failure-preserving journal, and stabilized-dawn prose expose the selected field consumer without revealing internal effect ids.

On a truthful byre-held return, Albany names either Jamie's staffed Market warm room or the returned mobile Campus cache, shows its 15-minute term, and records one-time consumption. Cade's field-only allocation truthfully produces neither return offer.

forks.title: Choose how and when to reach the steading
forks.visible_choice: On the Station Quarter quest card, take the exposed ridge for 30 minutes, 1 supply, and 25 fatigue or the sheltered stockway for 75 minutes, 2 supplies, and 10 fatigue. Before the single quest-start decision, a bounded route summary combines the selected oath and relief allocation with both roads: ridge clean alarm is 4 at baseline, 3 with either Cade fodder or Aid-Only, and 2 with both; stockway clean alarm is 3 at baseline and 2 with Aid-Only, while Cade fodder explicitly leaves that road unchanged.
delayed_consumers: The selected knowledge imports as exactly one route flag. It makes exactly one last-mile action legal, and taking the exposed descent starts cattle alarm at 1 while the sheltered gate leaves it at 0; contradictory flags authorize neither route.

The first committed lure cast reads the route flag: exposed ridge uses DC 10 and sheltered stockway uses DC 12. At seed 9 only the ridge succeeds; the stockway permanently fouls the cast and exposes the authored split-rail recovery instead of an identical retry.

At seed 26 both first casts succeed. Under a non-aid oath and without Cade fodder, the ridge's clean three-cast line reaches alarm 4 and the two-cattle-scattered living-pack ending, while the stockway reaches alarm 3 and the whole-herd living-pack ending. Cade fodder suppresses the ridge's clean first-cast step but does not alter the stockway; Aid-Only suppresses the final clean-cast step on either road, and combines with fodder to bring the ridge to alarm 2.

Exact launch cost, Hayden route memory, route-qualified decision proof, quest import receipt, and route return summary survive quest foldback and save/restore. A versioned launch seal binds the actual hill approach and decision boundary to selected or explicitly declined preparation, allocation, and field-team slots plus the authenticated dispatch ledger; v10 stripping and mutation fail closed while legitimate v9 launches backfill once. Remaining overworld supplies, fatigue, and clock state continue into Albany travel and services.
visible_feedback: Full MCP, compact MCP, browser, and CLI show each actual time/supply/fatigue cost, projected arrival, remaining supplies, resulting condition, blocked reason, and one exact conditional field-tradeoff summary before commitment. The dedicated summary is bounded and never compact-truncated; Cade fodder and Aid-Only each replace baseline-only alarm claims with their exact combined clean-lure result while leaving authored and persisted proof unchanged.

Every Station preparation, allocation, and ally comparison keeps the selected-only title/status/timing plan adjacent. Compact MCP inspection repeats only that authenticated bounded recap with its unchanged receipt, terminal inspection prints it before the comparison, and the browser renders it before the option cards; exact active terms remain pull-based and no alternative terms leak.

Compact quest launch explicitly names Albany Station -> The Wolf-Winter, the accepted road, imported or declined preparation, and an actionable child state. Its receipt keeps only the selected route while the full parent journey remains available through the unchanged parent session handle.
Arrival prose and the sole route action name the chosen road; the first cast shows its exact DC and no-retry result, and the visible cattle-alarm band exposes the threshold difference.

The start journal, persistent character panel, RPG import receipt, ending, quest-completion journal, and restored snapshot retain the selected approach without exposing hidden effect ids in player projections.

forks.title: Accept Cade's household terms or invoke Albany authority
forks.visible_choice: Accept Cade's household fortification terms and retain his failed-seal help, or invoke lawful Albany authority and spend public relief seals while Cade refuses that recovery.
delayed_consumers: Cade's stance-specific aid or refusal after the first seal fails

An unstabilized failed first seal reaches Strained pressure 3: solo or broken-June dawn costs a persistent 2 HP, while intact June's paid cattle-first authority absorbs that strain without changing pressure or ending. Clean pressure 2 costs nothing; a mobile-stabilized failed line also costs nothing and gains no June injury benefit, even when delayed dispatch leaves it at pressure 3
Exposed outer property versus spent public relief stock
Cade and Hayden's return memories and mutually exclusive Station service
visible_feedback: Cade discloses both stances, their finite resource, the loss each protects, and June's exact pressure-3 dawn benefit before commitment.

The visible Winter Siege band, June's pressure-specific dialogue, blocked dawn action, solo/June HP split, no-retry recovery, dawn account, Albany dispatch, Hayden response, and service all name the selected conduct and cost.

forks.title: Commit to a materially different wolf resolution strategy
forks.visible_choice: Before entering the breach, ask about Cade's feed plan without cost, then either decline it or explicitly commit his one finite winter-feed sack to three downwind casts. The feed plan forecasts visible cattle alarm, no clean retry after a fouled first cast, split-rail recovery, and a bounded one-fight hybrid fallback.
delayed_consumers: A clean feed commitment removes combat from all three encounters and preserves every wolf at full implicit HP; the established prepared combat route instead defeats all three.

A failed first stockway cast permanently raises cattle alarm from 0 to 2; the exposed ridge already starts at 1 and its failed cast truthfully reports the full +2 rise to 3. Both remove the identical retry. Spending a failed split rail preserves the all-alive route; fighting only the yearling creates a bounded hybrid with its own survivor identity.

On the pure combat route, defeating both younger wolves while falling to 12 health or less opens one pre-maneuver evacuation instead of forcing old grey or death. Taking it ends the defense immediately: people escape, old grey remains in the abandoned byre, and two cattle go missing. HP 13, any living younger wolf, any strategy commitment, or any old-grey maneuver withholds it.
Cattle alarm 3 keeps the herd whole, while alarm 4 leaves two cattle missing. Clean, recovered-noncombat, hybrid, and combat endings remain mechanically and textually distinct.

Quest exports give Cade and Emery ending-specific memories and world facts. Only the all-alive, whole-herd result unlocks Emery's one-time 15-minute Greenway resupply cache after the truthful Albany return.

Wolf bloodshed changes Emery's later legal agenda: a bloodless return permits quiet corridor policy, while hybrid or full-combat bloodshed forbids that policy and opens an evidence-custody line with two matching survey actions. The accessible public detour remains legal in every case.
visible_feedback: Byre-Yard arrival copy points directly to Cade's optional HUNT, LURE, DRIVE, and FORTIFY comparison at the natural field commitment point; his free explanation, separate commitment prompt, finite non-droppable feed, locked pre-breach handoff, room copy, and legal actions expose the plan and its irreversibility before execution without adding a mandatory decision.
Full MCP, compact MCP, and browser views show exact Steady, Restless, and Breaking cattle-alarm bands with the next threshold.

Ending, Albany dispatch, Emery's reactive Greenway copy, campaign facts and memories, and the conditional service all name the exact wolf/cattle count rather than collapsing mixed and noncombat results.

The bloodied evacuation action appears beside old grey's combat choices only at its exact threshold and states its terminal cost before use; its ending, Cade/Emery/June memory, Albany return, and both dawn dispatches preserve the two dead wolves, surviving old grey, safe people, missing cattle, and abandoned byre.
Full, compact, browser, and MCP Greenway projections expose only the two policies legal for the proven Wolf outcome; withheld quiet or custody option ids, titles, copy, and terms do not leak.

forks.title: Choose what to protect at the drive's crisis point
forks.visible_choice: After Cade discloses that committing to his two-charge drive-and-evacuate plan starts the moving herd immediately, closes preparation/backtracking, forfeits the outer steading defense line on every completion, and leaves no switch to lure or combat, turn both younger wolves alive and choose one irreversible protection priority at the visible Pack Drive crisis: keep the entire herd together by taking an untreated gate wound, clear every person while two cattle scatter, or sacrifice Albany's spent signal-and-rope rig so people and the whole herd clear unharmed.
delayed_consumers: The chosen priority makes exactly one distinct final evacuation action legal; all three pay the pre-disclosed outer-defense forfeiture and separate the living pack from the steading without relabeling a combat or failed-lure route.

Quest export records mutually exclusive persistent wound, cattle-scattered, or reserve-spent state. The cattle-first wound reduces campaign health 30→24 and remains untreated through ordinary rest and resupply; full, compact, UI, and save/restore projections preserve its exact treatment state.

Cade's exact witness memory plus the exact untreated gate wound open one 45-minute Station care action. Care restores 6 health up to the existing maximum, advances only that wound to treated, spends no supplies, changes no fatigue, and reopens only the deep public or quiet Greenway survey matching the player's existing policy.

A returned rig unlocks June Pike's one-time 15-minute Station rest; a whole herd unlocks Emery Sloane's one-time 15-minute Greenway resupply. The cattle-first result earns both offers, people-first only the rest, and reserve-spent only the resupply.

June and Emery retain distinct memories and return testimony for the wound, cattle loss, or spent rig. If June accompanied the player, she first takes the lower cattle gate under her remembered authority. On a failed-signal route that action lowers Pack Drive from Overrun 3 to Crisis 2 without the solo route's -2 HP brace; a clean signal remains at 2. The cattle-first promise remains kept on every bloodless evacuation.

The hard drive commitment withholds every wolf and combat action before the first signal, through failed-signal recovery, and at the threshold. The ordinary three-wolf spear route remains available only if the player declines before the cattle move, so combat cannot be sampled and folded back into a bloodless ending.
visible_feedback: Pack Drive is a visible pressure track with Moving, Crisis, Overrun, and Cleared bands; the failed opening reaches crisis pressure early, cannot be retried, and exposes a one-shot loose-hurdle recovery. After the second signal, solo Overrun requires a persistent -2 HP swing-gate brace, while June's pre-disclosed cattle-first lower gate absorbs that extra beat without changing the later three-way priority.

Cade states the universal outer-defense forfeiture before drive commitment; each crisis option then states its additional irreversible wound, cattle, or rig cost, and the journal names the sole evacuation action that remains legal afterward.
The ending, Albany character copy, persistent-character panel, and named service offers repeat exactly what survived and what was lost.

Station care names Cade's witnessed wound, its exact 45-minute cost, treatment advance, and health change. Greenway's fast option remains visible before care while its deep option explains the Station treatment dependency and appears only after treatment.

forks.title: Use sound wood now or carry it into the aftermath
forks.visible_choice: Bar the cattle gate with surviving wood or retain it for repairing the outer paling after the immediate crisis.
delayed_consumers: The exported Wolf-Winter world fact selects one mutually exclusive, one-time Albany Station Quarter service: retained timber returns repair-wagon stores for a 15-minute resupply, while committed guard wood releases a Road Warden cot for a 15-minute rest.
After the offer is consumed, its journal-bound rule id removes it across save/restore and the ordinary 45-minute resupply or 180-minute minimum rest applies again.

Paired reachable resource states reverse the advantage: retained timber saves 30 minutes when supplies are low, while committed guard wood saves 165 minutes after identical road strain creates fatigue.
visible_feedback: The gate interaction states that the guard can bar the herd's inner gate now or be carried into dawn for the broken outer paling.
On the Albany return, full view, compact MCP context, and the web UI name the unlocked one-time service, its cause, its effect, and its 15-minute term beside the affected action.
The service result repeats the authored cause and exact resource change; consumption removes the offer while the persistent service journal binds the rule and Station Quarter area.

forks.title: Allocate the truthful Albany response
forks.visible_choice: After the actual Wolf-Winter ending is reported, send Albany's only dawn wagon back to Cade and carry Hedrick's packet alone, or send the wagon and wardens north and travel with them. Each option discloses its mutually exclusive named-NPC service credit before commitment.
delayed_consumers: The selected branch is recovered generically from the trusted current or historical journey goal, so its consequence survives later goal activation without a duplicate mutable save field.
Sending the wagon to Cade makes Jamie Tanner's one-time Market road-store credit available: resupply takes 15 minutes instead of the ordinary 45.
Sending the wagon and wardens north makes Emery Sloane's one-time Greenway watch-shelter claim available: rest takes 15 minutes instead of the ordinary 180.

At Cade's later Station return packet, sending the wagon to Cade suppresses the already-repaired paling and evacuation-line assignments, while sending the wardens north preserves whichever structural assignment the Wolf-Winter outcome proves. A proven missing-cattle loss preserves Emery's lower-pasture search under either dawn dispatch.
The mutually exclusive rule-and-area journal proof consumes the selected credit across save/restore; the other provider never offers the unchosen benefit.
visible_feedback: Before commitment, both dispatch consequences name Jamie or Emery, the Market or Greenway district, the affected action, the one-time nature, and the 15-minute term.
Full overworld and UI views identify the named provider and repeat the authored branch cause; compact MCP context preserves the provider name, cause, action, and minutes in its bounded offer tuple.

The full, compact, UI, MCP, and opportunity surfaces all omit Cade's structural packet work after the wagon repairs it, retain that work after the wardens branch, and keep the lower-pasture search visible under either branch when cattle are missing.

The service result repeats the cause and exact resource transition; consumption removes the offer, and its persistent journal binds the selected story proof, rule, provider district, and decision boundary.

forks.title: Bind Albany's winter price policy, then settle its disputed crates
forks.visible_choice: After Wolf-Winter, Jamie Tanner irreversibly either holds named household and kitchen prices or publishes an open-bid ceiling and visible buyer board. The later disputed-crates job offers only that policy's two exact settlements: household-price releases cost 30 or 75 minutes for 3 or 5 standing, while open-bid releases cost 20 or 60 minutes for 1 or 4 standing.
delayed_consumers: The resolved Market event option is the sole predicate for two later disputed-crate settlements; the opposite policy's options are never legal.

From the reachable held-byre return at 8 standing, either policy adds 2 standing. The household fast release then reaches 13 and exposes Albany's existing Civic recovery cot in 30 minutes; the open-bid fast release ends at 11 but saves 10 minutes. The household audit reaches 15 in 75 minutes, while the open-bid audit reaches 14 in 60 minutes, preserving the same time-versus-standing frontier at the thorough depth.

Exact event and job proof, option-local predicates, journal/resource/renown replay, and full/compact/UI/MCP projection survive structural save/restore; a content-hash mismatch is only a warning and cannot create either policy proof.
visible_feedback: Jamie names the irreversible price policy, the protected kitchens or visible buyer board, and its later crate consequence before confirmation.
The crates prompt repeats the previously selected policy, exposes exactly one fast operational release and one slower audited chain, and states that policy's exact time and standing before selection.

The completed journal names the ledger or board used; the Civic counter visibly offers its existing 13-standing recovery after the household fast counterfactual, while the ten-minute-faster open-bid fast counterfactual remains below threshold.

forks.visible_choice: After Wolf-Winter, Emery Sloane always offers an obvious accessible public detour around the damaged Greenway crossing. A bloodless return also permits low-profile wildlife-corridor markers; those two policies each cost 35 minutes and earn 2 Capital / Mohawk renown. Hybrid or full-combat bloodshed instead permits a quicker internal evidence-custody record at 30 minutes/+1 and forbids relabeling the result as quiet conservation. No selected record can later be relabeled.
delayed_consumers: Emery's later corridor-survey board reads the exact event-option proof and exposes only the two follow-ups lawful under the public, quiet, or custody line. State without that exact proof satisfies none of the branches.

Structural restore retains the policy the player actually selected and its matching follow-up. A content-hash mismatch never invents or relabels a custody choice. New bloodshed decisions cannot select quiet policy, while bloodless quiet and universal public records remain unchanged.
visible_feedback: The investigated event presents only the two outcome-lawful policies with exact immediate terms and names their distinct later public-access, corridor-preservation, or evidence-custody work before commitment.
The later full, compact, browser, and MCP job board shows two policy-matching actions and withholds the other four; the completed event journal retains the selected policy and consequence.

forks.title: Choose survey speed or a durable Greenway record
forks.visible_choice: Within the already-authored trail policy or custody record, choose a faster practical field mark or a slower durable survey. Public policy offers a 30-minute/+3 shortest detour or 75-minute/+5 all-weather loop; quiet policy offers 20-minute/+1 steward markers or a 60-minute/+4 witnessed wildlife-corridor trace; bloodshed custody instead offers a 15-minute/+1 minimum seal or a 70-minute/+5 witnessed chain of custody without borrowing the quiet policy's claim.
delayed_consumers: The chosen public, quiet, or custody survey remains a distinct replay-bound journal consequence and persistent Capital / Mohawk standing result across later travel and save/restore, while deliberately granting no new rest or resupply coupon.

From the reachable 8-standing post-Wolf state, public policy plus its short detour takes 65 total minutes and reaches Rowan's existing 13-standing Civic recovery threshold; quiet policy plus its short markers takes 55 and ends at 11; custody plus its minimum seal takes 45 and ends at 10. The deep custody chain takes 100 total minutes and reaches 14, creating a third non-isomorphic time/standing frontier.
visible_feedback: Each legal survey card states its exact duration, standing, and policy- or custody-specific field result before commitment.

The completion journal names the selected detour or corridor record; full, compact, browser, and MCP surfaces preserve the same legal pair and the restored campaign retains its exact time and standing.
On the paired short routes, Civic full view exposes Rowan's recovery cot only after the slower public work reaches 13 standing; quiet work visibly saves 10 minutes and withholds that existing offer.

forks.visible_choice: Before Wolf-Winter, Reese Pryce offers one optional hazard-shift charter on equal 20-minute/+1-standing terms: license a named public-shift witness count or authorize a measured cold-set safety-gate bypass. The charter expires once Wolf-Winter is complete and never gates departure.

Exact event-option proof appends only the matching return method: a 45-minute/+3 witnessed release or a 60-minute/+4 cold-set bypass. State without that proof unlocks neither.

The witnessed release ends at 12 and is 15 minutes faster than the bypass when already rested; the bypass ends at 13 and opens Rowan's existing 15-minute Civic recovery cot, beating the witness route plus ordinary 180-minute rest when fatigued.

The post-Wolf full, compact, browser, and MCP job board preserves both base priorities, shows only the charter-matching third method, and withholds the opposite authorization. The unresolved pre-Wolf event expires and never appears as a return opportunity, while its already-discovered Works job remains eligible for the normal return lead.

Save/restore and decision replay retain the exact event and job proofs. A content revision produces an explicit provenance warning without inventing either charter capability, while altered causal evidence fails closed.

forks.title: Choose Albany Campus's return-evidence mandate
forks.visible_choice: After Wolf-Winter, Scout the Campus POI, speak with Blair Drake, and investigate the return-evidence mandate. Blair then asks whether to prioritize clinic exposure thresholds or preserve traceable route provenance. Each irreversible record states the matching additional Archive Query method and one-use Campus service before confirmation; it does not replace either established Archive Query method.

State without an exact mandate proof unlocks neither optional method nor either new service.

The resulting service names the selected evidence record and, where applicable, the consolidated Drover or mobile credit; consumption removes it across save/restore.

forks.title: Bind Hayden's Cade return filing standard
forks.visible_choice: After Wolf-Winter, Scout the Station POI, speak with Hayden Hale, and investigate the Cade Return Filing Standard. Bind either an operational route abstract or a named-witness return. Both cost 20 minutes and earn 1 Capital / Mohawk renown; each states its one matching administrative Cade Return Packet close before confirmation, neither closes the packet at filing time, and neither is required for first-goal completion. Completing any packet method first removes the filing event instead of leaving a dead choice.

Both administrative closes preserve the existing broken-paling, abandoned-line, and missing-cattle dispatches whenever their Wolf-Winter facts and dawn-dispatch predicates permit. Choosing a close completes the administrative record but records no physical work, creates no rest or resupply claim, and leaves every certified physical loss honestly deferred.

From the lowest 8-standing held return, either filing choice first reaches 9. The operational close ends at 12 and is 15 minutes faster when already rested; the witnessed close ends at 13 and opens Rowan's existing 15-minute Civic recovery cot, beating the quick line plus ordinary 180-minute recovery when fatigued.
Because the event requires completed Wolf-Winter and every action is optional, the filing standard adds no decision to the first-goal path.
visible_feedback: Before Wolf-Winter the Station filing event is absent. After return it remains inaccessible until the player has scouted the Station POI, talked with Hayden, and investigated it; full, compact, UI, and MCP surfaces expose the same two exact choices and terms.

The Cade Return Packet board retains every currently lawful physical dispatch and appends only the close matching the resolved filing proof. Its copy states that administrative closure dispatches no crew, grants no recovery claim, and leaves physical losses deferred.

The unresolved event and eligible Cade job remain truthful optional opportunity leads until one packet method is complete. Event/job journals and structural save/restore retain exact proofs; a content-hash mismatch warns without inventing a filing choice, while relabelled, reversed, or divergent causal evidence fails closed.
